Can you escalate this? I wanna know how many workspaces I have available as a silver member, and what it takes to enable the AI SDR/Cold Email agent

EARLIER TURNS (context only: they resolve what "it", "that" or a follow-up refers to while the subject is the same, and do not carry over once the latest message changes subject. Only recent messages are shown and some may be cut, so a detail missing here is not proof the customer never gave it):
Customer: Process to get a new workspace open for a client. I have 2 or 4 free workspaces as I am on silver plan
Support: 1. From your dashboard, click the Workspace Switcher dropdown in the top-left corner.
2. Click New Workspace at the bottom of the dropdown.
3. In the Create Workspace dialog, enter your client's business name in the Workspace Name field.
4. Click Create Workspace.
5. Complete Onboarding with the client's website, business type, sales method, and primary bottleneck.
6. Once created, go to Settings, then Members in the left sidebar.
7. In the Invite Member card, enter your client's email address.
8. Select Client from the role dropdown.
9. Click Send Invite.
Customer: then how do i turn on the cold email agent and SDR for the client
Support: If you use a white-label partner portal, ask your partner to enable the Cold Email Agent and AI SDR for client access.
